displayName: OCI-AI-PD-021: AI — Social Engineering via LLM
description:
Detects social engineering attempts leveraging LLM capabilities to manipulate users

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_pd_021", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%social%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%engineering%') AND "value" > 0
